why: Each figure is a circle with a pointed tail and a black dot. In options 1, 2, 3 and 5, the dot sits a little anticlockwise from the tail (the same figure, just turned). In option 4 the dot sits clockwise from the tail, so it is a mirror image. Option 4 is different.
trick: Turn each figure in your head so the tail points up, then see if the dot is on its left or right.
